releaseNotes: Fixed observation photographs showing in the app but not in the generated PDF.
Adds observation attachments to the PDF photographic-reference pages with observation number, code and location captions.
Keeps standalone reference photographs and observation photographs together without printing the same stored path twice.
Handles compatible phone image formats and skips missing or unreadable optional files without blocking PDF generation.
Preserves existing reports, backups, report locking and history.
